description: Dutch gross-to-net pay for 2026 (Belastingdienst tables), with or without the 30% ruling, as on our net salary calculator: net per month and year plus the tax breakdown. Example: gross=60000, period='yearly', ruling_30=true.

gross.description: Gross salary in euros, e.g. 60000 a year or 4500 a month

includes_holiday_allowance.description: The amount already includes the 8% holiday allowance (vakantiegeld). Default false, as most Dutch job ads quote salary without it.

period.description: Whether the gross amount is per year or per month

ruling_30.description: Has the 30% ruling (expat scheme). Default false.

under_30_with_masters.description: With the 30% ruling: under 30 with a Dutch (or equivalent) master's degree (lower salary minimum). Default false.

name: net_salary
title: Dutch net salary calculator 2026
